name: Saffi Eriksdotter
description: Hans's sister, killed and eaten by the lhurgoyf.

description_citations.text: "The Monsters of Magic". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Saffi Eriksdotter shouts a warning about the Lhurgoyf as her last words.

citation.text: Lhurgoyf (Ice Age, 1995), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Saffi Eriksdotter's last words warn Hans to run from the Lhurgoyf.
timeline.quote: Ach! Hans, run! It's the Lhurgoyf!

citation.text: Lhurgoyf (Oversized League Prizes, 1998), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Saffi strides from deep snow to dusty waste while a voice calls after her.
timeline.quote: In the blink of an eye, she strode from deep snow to dusty waste.

citation.text: Saffi Eriksdotter (Time Spiral, 2006), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: A lhurgoyf kills and eats Saffi while hunting the poachers who stole its eggs.
timeline.quote: kills and eats Saffi, while Hans flees back to their town for protection.

citation.text: "The Monsters of Magic", section "Ach! Hans, Run! , by Will McDermott". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.quote: It encounters the siblings Hans Eriksson and Saffi Eriksdotter
